components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink block for confirming actions; inverts inside the frame.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #121212; color: #f4f1ea; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 14px Barlow, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms, transform 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #36332e; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #845500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Accent Button
components.description: The one carton-yellow action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-accent { background: #e4a11b; color: #121212; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; font: 600 14px Barlow, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: #eeb53f; } .ds-btn-accent:active { background: #cf8d0c; } .ds-btn-accent:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #845500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: transparent; color: #121212; height: 40px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1.5px solid rgb(18 18 18 / 0.85); border-radius: 4px; font: 600 14px Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgb(18 18 18 / 0.06); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #845500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Category filter in condensed caps; selected is solid ink.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 28px; padding: 0 10px; margin-right: 4px; border: 1px solid #cdc6b8; border-radius: 4px; background: transparent; color: #36332e; font: 700 11.5px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #121212; color: #121212; } .ds-chip--on { background: #121212; border-color: #121212; color: #f4f1ea; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Form-white field with a hairline and an accent-ink focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 240px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #cdc6b8; border-radius: 4px; background: #fffdf9; color: #121212; font: 400 13px Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #6e685f; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #845500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Carton Bar
components.description: The chrome-yellow shell bar with the three-band mark and the band rule under it.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 56px; padding: 0 16px; background: #e4a11b; color: #121212; } .ds-bar-back { display: flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 4px; background: #121212; color: #e4a11b; font: 700 13px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-mark { display: flex; width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 2px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #121212; } .ds-mark i { flex: 1; } .ds-mark i:nth-child(1) { background: #c8322b; } .ds-mark i:nth-child(2) { background: #e4a11b; } .ds-mark i:nth-child(3) { background: #2f6db5; } .ds-bar-name { font: 800 22px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-band-rule { height: 7px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #e4a11b 0 1px, #c8322b 1px 4px, #2f6db5 4px 7px); }

components.name: Film Carton
components.description: A look: carton ink, stock code and numeral, photo window, two-line name, band strip; lifts when chosen.
components.css: .ds-carton { display: flex; flex-direction: column; width: 140px; padding: 0; border: 0; border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; background: #2f6db5; color: #f4f1ea; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 200ms, box-shadow 200ms; } .ds-carton:hover, .ds-carton:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-8px); box-shadow: 0 10px 22px -10px rgb(18 18 18 / 0.45); outline: 2px solid #121212; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-carton-code { padding: 8px 8px 6px; font: 700 11px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; } .ds-carton-code b { font-size: 34px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-carton-window { margin: 0 8px; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #c7cdd0 0 35%, #4c6b34 35% 75%, #36452c 75%); } .ds-carton-name { padding: 6px 8px 8px; font: 700 15px/1.02 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-carton-band { height: 3px; opacity: 0.6; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #c8322b 0 33.3%, #e4a11b 33.3% 66.6%, #2f6db5 66.6%); } .ds-carton:hover .ds-carton-band { height: 7px; opacity: 1; }

components.name: Edge Print
components.description: The line printed along the black frame under the photo.
components.html: Frame 01ALook Airy Pastel Negative · 100%
components.css: .ds-edge { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; height: 28px; padding: 0 16px; background: #0b0b0b; color: #f0b941; font: 600 11px 'Barlow Condensed', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-edge-dim { color: #8f8a81; } .ds-edge-dot { width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: #8f8a81; }

narrative.overview: Every look is a box of film you pick off a shelf and load into your photo. The chrome is printed carton: warm print paper, ink type, a chrome-yellow bar with a red / yellow / blue band strip under it. The photo always sits in a black frame with a line of edge printing that says which frame is loaded and which look is in it. It is an Operate surface: the world lends type, palette, density and one signature move, never the layout or the controls.
keyCharacteristics: Paper chrome, ink type, one chrome-yellow bar per screen with the band strip printed under it.
A black frame (.theme-frame) around every photo, with edge printing in condensed tracked caps.
Looks as colour cartons: stock code, display numeral, photo window, band strip at the foot.
Condensed caps (Barlow Condensed) for titles, labels and print; Barlow for reading text.
Crisp 2-6px corners, flat fields, one soft lift shadow for things that rise.

rules.name: The Scoped Theme Rule
rules.body: Components use role tokens, never raw values; the same component renders on paper, inside .theme-frame or on .theme-carton without a variant.

rules.name: The Photo Is The Only Picture Rule
rules.body: On an editing screen nothing competes with the photo: no gradients, glows, blurred backdrops or ambient colour behind it.

rules.name: The Caps Are Printed Rule
rules.body: Condensed caps are for printed things; sentences, help text and values stay in sentence-case Barlow.

rules.name: The Off The Shelf Rule
rules.body: Only a chosen or hovered carton lifts; nothing else floats at rest.

dos: Do put every new screen under the carton bar and band rule (CartonBar).
Do show photos inside .theme-frame, never on paper.
Do give anything that represents a look a carton ink, a stock code and a numeral.
Do keep one Carton Yellow action per screen; everything else is ink or outline.
Do honour reduced motion: the shelf stocking (GSAP) and the edge-print roll are skipped.
donts: Don't use frosted glass, glows, gradients or blurred photo backdrops; the world is printed.
Don't use Carton Yellow as text on paper; use Accent Ink.
Don't imitate real film brands' cartons, logos or stock names.
Don't use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons; use Lucide at the surrounding stroke.
Don't use pills or circles for buttons and chips.
